entries.zh: 悟；醒悟、领会，留心觉察
entries.en: to realize, become aware; to take notice, heed

entries.zh: 悟了；已然醒悟，须臾即觉
entries.en: realized, come to one's senses; to realize at once

entries.zh: 煽；煽动挑拨，以谄言拨弄人心（义同阿谀奉承）
entries.en: to incite, stir up; to flatter, coax (same as lisonjear)

entries.zh: 煽惑；谄媚蛊惑，以奉诱行骗
entries.en: to incite and beguile; to flatter in order to deceive

entries.zh: 口扇（口旁加扇之合体字）；以言语煽动哄骗
entries.en: to beguile with words; verbal coaxing meant to deceive
entries.notes: 汉字栏为口旁加扇之合体字，义据西语栏与两音栏而定。

entries.zh: 谀；阿谀奉承以哄骗
entries.en: to flatter, curry favor (in order to deceive)

entries.zh: 谀媚；阿谀谄媚
entries.en: flattery and fawning

entries.zh: 谄；谄媚——当面奉承，背后诋毁
entries.en: to fawn and flatter, then backbite

entries.zh: 谄谀；谄媚阿谀，先谄后毁
entries.en: fawning and flattery; to flatter now, slander afterwards

entries.zh: 谄媚；阿谀奉承，事后毁谤
entries.en: to fawn on and flatter (and afterwards backbite)

entries.zh: 谄他；奉承讨好其人（伊＝他／她）
entries.en: to flatter him or her
entries.notes: 伊为闽南语第三人称他／她。

entries.zh: 好嘴（书作好口）；嘴甜话多，能言善媚
entries.en: glib and talkative; smooth-mouthed flatterer

entries.zh: 冷言；讥讽反话，冷嘲之语（以冷语作反讽式奉承）
entries.en: to flatter ironically; cold, sarcastic words

entries.zh: 冷语；冷嘲讥讽之言
entries.en: sarcastic words; ironic speech

entries.zh: 同人嘴（书作同人口）；随声附和，假装附从、曲意顺从他人意愿
entries.en: to echo another's words and follow his will; flattering by feigned agreement

entries.zh: 藏嘴（书作藏口）；缄口不扬人过，以隐默讨好
entries.en: to keep silent about faults, conceal; flattering by holding one's tongue

entries.zh: 口腹；巧言奉承以谋利之人（义同甜言慰悦）
entries.en: flatterer (lit. mouth and belly); same as caricias, fond coaxing
entries.notes: 口腹字面为口与腹，对应 adulador／caricias 之理据依语境推断；闽南语栏另有括注未详。

entries.zh: 奸夫；路人——在外游荡、不守夫道之男子
entries.en: adulterer (male); lit. man of the road
entries.notes: uaron 为 17 世纪 u／v 通写之 varón（男子）。

entries.zh: 奸夫；路头翁——路头野汉，在外游荡之男
entries.en: adulterer; lit. man of the roadside
entries.notes: 官话音栏仅记前二字之音，未及第三字。

entries.zh: 奸妇；失节之妇（失去夫节）
entries.en: adulteress; lit. one who has lost her man, i.e. her chastity
entries.notes: 汉字栏似失郎，而两音栏所示更近失节，故取两读均可立之失节之妇义。
